verdict.rationale: The plugins docs index lists a page to "Implement event subscriptions and webhook delivery for your MCP server" (docs-59), so the platform does document event subscriptions and webhook delivery for plugin MCP servers. That evidence is a single one-line index entry with no detail on how a user subscribes, which events exist, payload format, or delivery guarantees. The hooks.json companion file (gh-11) is not clearly webhook-related, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: actual webhook docs content (event catalog, subscription API, payload schema, signing/retries), clarity that end users rather than only plugin developers can subscribe, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
